reason: Tokilake is primarily a self-hosted external-service gateway that exposes an OpenAI-compatible API and routes requests to distributed GPU workers through NAT-traversing tunnels, with registration and failover features.

summaries.zh: Tokilake 是一个自托管 AI 网关，用于通过 OpenAI 兼容 API 将请求路由到分布在不同网络中的本地 GPU 模型工作节点。
summaries.en: Tokilake is a self-hosted AI gateway that routes OpenAI-compatible API requests to local GPU model workers distributed across different networks.

capabilities: Provides an OpenAI-compatible API gateway for local and distributed LLM workers
Routes inference requests across registered Ollama, vLLM, SGLang, and other workers
Establishes outbound WebSocket or QUIC reverse tunnels for workers behind NAT
Supports worker registration, heartbeat monitoring, load balancing, and failover
Offers gateway features including authentication, billing, and multi-tenant access
